claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a standing fan with a logo/mark on the hub that is not fully readable; no clear brand/model text is captured.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: No photo/clip shows battery capacity, charging status, runtime test, or speed/low-mode behavior.

risks.risk: Battery/runtime may be weak or degraded (claim of up to 2 hours may not hold).
risks.proof: A short video of the fan running from full charge with a visible timer (e.g., phone stopwatch) on the stated speed settings until it cuts out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a rechargeable fan with unknown battery health (worst case: battery not reliable / short runtime).

risks.risk: Fan may not run smoothly or may have motor issues (noise, stalling, weak airflow).
risks.proof: A video showing the fan turned on at multiple speeds with steady rotation and normal airflow.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/possibly faulty operation.

risks.risk: Blade condition may be damaged (cracks, bends) causing wobble or vibration.
risks.proof: Close-up video while spinning showing no wobble/vibration, plus still close-ups of each blade edge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having potential blade wear (worst case: vibration/imbalance).

risks.risk: Tilt/oscillation mechanism may be loose or not working correctly.
risks.proof: Video demonstrating tilt/oscillation movement and that it holds position without slipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tilt/oscillation unverified (worst case: weak/doesn’t hold).

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (damaged plug/cable, loose connection).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the plug end and cable length, plus a video showing stable power connection without sparking/heat.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical condition unknown (worst case: cable/plug may need replacement).

risks.risk: Missing parts or poor base stability (screws/covers/stand integrity).
risks.proof: Bottom/base photo showing all screws/covers and a clip of the fan standing stable when switched on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown parts (worst case: base stability issues).

risks.proof: Photo of the rating label/spec plate (wattage, diameter, speed modes) on the motor housing or back of the head.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic standing fan with unknown specs (worst case: lower power).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the brand/model and rating label (wattage, fan diameter/size, number of speed modes).
Video: turn on and show all speed settings working properly.
Video: demonstrate tilt/oscillation (if any) and show it holds position.
Video: show runtime test from full charge with a visible timer (and what speed setting was used).
Close-up photos of blades (both sides) and a spinning clip to confirm no wobble/cracks.
Photos of the plug end and full cable condition; show no loose wiring.
Bottom/base photo showing all screws/covers; clip showing stability on the floor.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a standing fan, but key value drivers for a rechargeable fan—battery health/runtime, electrical safety, and operating condition—are not shown in the report. Without at least a working/runtime proof, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
